QuestInfo.name: A Patient Hunger
QuestInfo.0: #b#p603##k in #m10005000# has a warning that must reach #m10004000#.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p603##k thinks the hunger under #m10005000# is the same darkness #b#p502##k felt long ago. I need to take his warning to #b#p502##k in #m10004000#.
QuestInfo.2: I told #b#p502##k what #b#p603##k found. He said whatever is down there doesn't wake up all at once. It drinks the warmth first.

0.0: I've been thinking about those tails all night. Something is waiting under #m10005000#. It's patient, and it's hungry.
0.1: I'm only an herbalist. But there's a man in #m10004000# who has felt this darkness before. #b#p502##k knows the Ant Tunnel better than anyone.
0.2: Please go to #m10004000# and tell #b#p502##k what we found. He has to hear this.

yes.0: Thank you. Tell him about the cold spring, and the faces in our dreams. He'll understand.

no.0: I see. But someone must tell him. Please think about it.

1.0: #b#p603##k sent you? ...Cold tails with no warmth left in them. Faces in your dreams.
1.1: I know that feeling. I felt it once, long ago. Whatever is down there doesn't wake up all at once. It drinks the warmth first.
1.2: You did right to come. Take this. If it's waking, I'll need people like you.

npc.0: Please go to #m10004000# and tell #b#p502##k what we found. He has to hear this.
